title: auth/oidc: OidcError missing std::error::Error impl
description: crates/auth/src/oidc.rs — OidcError implements Display but not std::error::Error. Library error types in Rust are expected to implement std::error::Error so callers can use ? to propagate them into Box<dyn Error> contexts, use .source() for cause chains, and use error-library integrations (anyhow, thiserror). Without this, OidcError cannot participate in the standard error chaining ecosystem. The Http(reqwest::Error) variant has a natural source() impl.
